title: Mossy Cobblestone Texture
summary: Seamless 768x768 top-down cobblestone with wet grey stones and green moss packed into the joints, generated prompt-only with a seamless model patch. Use for forest ruins, dungeon floors and overgrown paths; tiles cleanly on both axes at 1x, and the matching normal/height maps came from the same run.

title: Mossloop Ambience
summary: Six-second stereo ambient bed of stacked low sine tones (G3, D4, G4) with slow tremolo, echo and fade in/out. Use as a quiet forest or menu loop; the fade makes it loop cleanly at six seconds.

title: Mossy Tile Camera Loop
summary: Six-second 1280x720 camera drift across the mossy cobblestone texture, pushing in slowly with a gentle sway. Use to demonstrate video playback or as a placeholder ambience plate; the still it was rendered from is the tileable texture bundle.

title: Sword Totem Splat
summary: 32,768-splat Gaussian reconstruction of a tall sword-shaped totem with a pale face at the guard, roughly 5.8 to 1 tall. Use to exercise the 3D splat viewer and as a stylized weapon or shrine prop reference; the PLY is the original and the poster is a viewport render.
